mapper.select: SELECT c.*, t.*, m.name as from_name FROM "h_coupon" c INNER JOIN "h_coupon_type" t ON c.coupon_num = t.coupon_num LEFT JOIN "h_member" m ON c.from_id = m.username WHERE c.to_id = #{username} ORDER BY c.date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "h_coupon" (from_id, to_id, coupon_num, date, status) VALUES (#{fromId}, #{toId}, #{couponNum}, #{date}, '미사용')

INSERT INTO "h_coupon_type" (category, percent, coupon_name, gym_id, coupon_date, coupon_count, send_count) VALUES (#{category}, #{percent}, #{couponName}, #{gymId}, #{couponDate, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{couponCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0)
